answer_1.quote: We evaluate the finetuning of BART-large on the XSum (Narayan et al., 2018) and CNN/DailyMail (Hermann et al., 2015) datasets for text summarization, reporting ROUGE-1/2/L scores for LoRA and OFTv2 under both full-precision and NormalFloat4 4-bit quantization.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include summaries for text summarization tasks and solutions to mathematical reasoning problems.
